units.source_text: 尽管这是私下谈心，没想到会把真情吐露到如此程度。

en.t: Although this was a private heart-to-heart conversation, I had not expected him to reveal his true feelings to such an extent.

units.source_text: 无论是什么场合，名人从不发牢骚，也不说泄气的话。

en.t: No matter what the occasion, the Master never complained, nor did he say anything dispirited.

units.source_text: 五十年的围棋生涯中，有不少次是由于比对手更有耐性而获胜的。

en.t: In his fifty-year career in go, there were many times when he won because he had more patience than his opponent.

units.source_text: 再说，名人绝不会故意哗众取宠，显示自己的悲壮和痛苦。

en.t: Besides, the Master would never deliberately play to the crowd by displaying his own tragic resolve and suffering.
